SCOUT3 V1.0 r0→r64 AUDIT
Infinity Grid — 2026-08-27

AUDIT VERDICT
=============

TRAJECTORY / EXECUTION: PASS.
SCIENTIFIC INTERPRETATION OF THE FROZEN OBSERVERS: REQUIRES CORRECTION.

Recommended audit status:

  SCOUT3_V1_0_TRAJECTORY_PASS_OBSERVER_INTERPRETATION_FAIL

The exact r0→r64 generated Scout trajectory is internally sound and reproducible. It should be preserved and reused. The audit does NOT support simply extending the unchanged V1.0 observer to r128, because the two observations that dominated the live interpretation — “H1 does not compress/recur” and “the O3 grammar has become quiet” — are substantially artifacts of how V1.0 defined those observers.

This does not produce an O3 entity. It does not falsify O3 either. It says V1.0 successfully generated a bounded exact O3 relation-addition trajectory, but its maturation camera is not yet the camera the frozen specification says it is.


1. EXECUTION AND REPRODUCIBILITY AUDIT
======================================

PASS.

Verified independently:

- Frozen manifest: 17 / 17 files match SHA-256.
- Official science SHA-256 recomputes exactly:
  de033dd4232df2a0ef33f0e813472de001d5df645699af0a19f5d68528176980
- 67 per-command stderr files: all 0 bytes.
- Detached controller record: PID 35308, PPID 1.
- Sample deterministic replay at r1, r32 and r64:
  selected carriers, observers, evaluations and d2 controls reproduced exactly;
  metric science fields reproduced exactly (wall time/RSS intentionally differ).
- Independent integrity sweep over all selected panels:
  4,867 carriers, 155,458 stored O3 incidences,
  0 illegal bridge endpoints,
  0 self-entity incidences,
  0 negative capacities,
  0 missing parent references,
  0 parent-count mismatches,
  0 stored component/beta mismatches.
- O2 source bank and O3 seed-panel internal science hashes recompute exactly.

The generated trajectory itself is therefore usable evidence and does not need to be regenerated.


2. CRITICAL FINDING C1 — H1 IS NOT THE FROZEN “CURRENT ACTION SUPPORT”
=====================================================================

The frozen spec says:

  “H1 means only 'same currently available actions'.”

The implementation does something materially finer.

site_state_colors() includes the exact triples

  (p, u_O2, U_O3)

where U_O3 is the exact current inter-O2 reservation count at each site and port type. h1_support() then hashes those exact site states into both site colors and whole-entity colors before labeling the currently legal actions.

So H1 does not merely ask:

  “What can this carrier do now?”

It also asks, implicitly:

  “What are the exact current resource counts of the sites/entities through which it can act?”

That is precisely the kind of distinction Scout2 taught us to keep OUT of a first current-support quotient and introduce later only if future transition behavior proves it necessary.

Observed consequence:

- direct_same_h1_selected = 0 at every single transition r1→r64.
- At r32, the entire exact generated child pool was:
    1,741 exact carriers → 1,726 implemented-H1 classes = 1.00869× compression.
- At r64:
    2,375 exact carriers → 2,367 implemented-H1 classes = 1.00338× compression.
- The selected r64 panel was:
    79 exact carriers → 79 implemented-H1 classes = 1.00000×.

This is not primarily a selection-panel effect; the implemented H1 is nearly unique even in the full generated pool.

AUDIT-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC
---------------------

To test whether this matters, an explicitly post-hoc diagnostic was run which defined a pure current-availability support signature using only whether each port type is currently available (>0), not its exact remaining multiplicity/reservation count.

This is NOT a scientific O3 result and may not be used for graduation or retrospective claim promotion. It is a diagnostic of whether the implementation matches the stated role of H1.

Under that diagnostic, the SAME selected r64 panel becomes:

  79 exact carriers → 23 current-support classes = 3.43478× compression.

Across the final r33→r64 32-level window, one support class exists at all 32 levels with:

- direct same-support parent recurrence: 31 / 31 transitions,
- multiple exact realizations: 32 / 32 checkpoints,
- lane types: D, I, L,
- cyclic: yes.

That class is not selective, so this audit-only replacement does NOT satisfy the complete frozen Scout trigger. No retrospective trigger is being claimed.

But the discrepancy is decisive: V1.0's reported “no compression / no recurrent H1” is not a trustworthy statement about current action support. The observer is overtyped.

Conclusion C1:

  H1 must be repaired before any prospective Scout3 extension.


3. CRITICAL FINDING C2 — “MAIN GRAMMAR QUIET” IS ALPHABET SATURATION
===================================================================

The live run appeared to show that the O3 rule vocabulary became quiet early and stayed quiet.
The code shows that the MAIN grammar observer is too small to support that interpretation.

MAIN atoms consist only of:

- RA:a-b  — an inherited Bridge-compatible typed relation pair is currently available;
- RU:a-b  — that inherited typed relation pair is currently used.

There are only 18 Bridge-compatible unordered relation types in the frozen port algebra.
Therefore MAIN has a hard ceiling of 36 atoms.

What happened:

- r0: all 18 RA atoms already present.
- r1: 17 of the 18 RU atoms appear.
- r2: final RU:1-4 appears.
- after r2: no new MAIN atom can be observed because the entire implemented alphabet is already exhausted.

The structural marker observer is similarly coarse: only 8 Boolean population-level markers.
All 8 have appeared by r2.

Therefore late satisfaction of:

- A_no_new_main_final16
- B_markers_stable32

does not demonstrate that a genuinely O3 organizational grammar has matured. It demonstrates that an inherited finite port-pair alphabet and an eight-marker checklist have saturated.

Meanwhile the resource/interface observer remains active through the horizon:

- new resource-support atoms appear at every one of the final 16 levels;
- cumulative resource-support atoms reach 964 by r64;
- cumulative exact resource atoms reach 3,146 by r64.

Conclusion C2:

  The final label FINITE_CONTROL_WITHOUT_O3_SCOUT_TRIGGER_V1_0 is too strong if read as “O3 finite control has been observed.”

The defensible statement is narrower:

  The inherited typed relation alphabet is saturated, relation addition remains live,
  and the exact/resource organization remains active at r64.

Scout3 V1.1 needs an O3-sensitive grammar observer that is not finite by construction at r2.


4. CRITICAL FINDING C3 — d2 IS NOT BEHAVIORALLY QUIET
======================================================

The d2 sidecar was interpreted during the run as a quiet control because no new d2 grammar atoms appeared after r0.

That is only true at the level of action TYPE vocabulary.

The 115 d2 atoms are inherited finite action types:

- rank-lift template/mode classes,
- internal O2 relation-pair classes.

They saturate immediately.

But the sidecar itself records substantial O3-interface effects from those same actions.
Across the nine d2 controls, 34.9% to 43.5% of exhausted d2 actions change the local external availability support.

At r64 specifically:

- d2 actions examined exactly: 7,211 rank lifts + 2,559 internal relation additions = 9,770;
- actions changing local external availability support: 4,249;
- changed fraction: 43.49%.

A separate audit-only exact materialization probe took 192 deterministic d2 actions from the frozen r64 d2 panel and recomputed the implemented O3 H1 after each action. 192 / 192 changed implemented H1.
(The latter is partly amplified by the H1 overtyping identified in C1, so it is not used as an independent scientific claim.)

The frozen d2 criterion K only tests:

- capacity integrity PASS;
- no NEW d2 action-type atoms.

It does not test whether d2 evolution leaves O3 behavior invariant.

Conclusion C3:

  d2 is a live coupled axis. It should not be described as behaviorally quiet.
  Scout3 V1.1 should materialize a bounded exact d2×r3 interaction panel and observe the resulting O3 support/grammar changes directly.


5. CRITICAL FINDING C4 — THE RUN DENSIFIES 3–6 ENTITIES; IT DOES NOT GROW O3
=============================================================================

Every Scout3 carrier inherits a fixed number of O2 entities from its r0 seed.
The seed sizes are 3, 4, 5 or 6. Relation addition never introduces a fresh O2 entity.

So r3 asks only:

  “What happens as more incidences are added among this already fixed small set?”

It does NOT ask:

  “What happens as an O3 organization grows by recruiting/attaching additional O2 carriers?”

By r64 the selected population is correspondingly very dense:

- 79 selected carriers;
- 55 / 79 contain 6 O2 entities;
- median beta3 = 60;
- median maximum parallel multiplicity = 19;
- maximum parallel multiplicity = 64.

Thus a large part of late-r3 organization is repeated/parallel incidence accumulation inside tiny fixed groups.

This is not wrong; it is a valid r3 densification experiment.
But it is not the complete O3 development program.

Scout2's central methodological lesson was to separate genuinely different construction axes rather than infer one from another. Scout3 V1.0 currently has:

- r3: inter-O2 relation addition;
- d2: internal O2 maturation only as a thin sidecar.

It lacks a third obvious axis:

- g3 / n3: attachment of a fresh graduated O2 Q entity to an existing O3 carrier through one lawful O3 incidence.

This is especially relevant because graduated Q carriers are recursively composable and can exceed the 2–6-site Q sizes represented in the current source bank.

Conclusion C4:

  A pure r65→r128 densification extension would deepen only one axis.
  Before doing that, Scout3 should explicitly decide how to cover fresh-entity growth.


6. SECONDARY FINDINGS
=====================

S1 — Frozen spec parameter contradiction
----------------------------------------
The spec's selection sections and README say official lane cap 16 and action cap 32.
The RESOURCE POLICY paragraph says official launch uses lane cap 24 and action cap 64.
The actual code/controller/log are unambiguous: 16 / 32 (bootstrap lane cap 32).
This is a documentation freeze inconsistency, not a numerical ambiguity.
Fix before V1.1.

S2 — “lineage” is not independently implemented in the trigger
-------------------------------------------------------------
evaluate() increments lineage_cp from the same multiparent_any Boolean used for multi_cp.
generation_action_count, although computed and used by lane L, is not used for the candidate lineage criterion.
Fix the wording or implement the intended independent lineage diagnostic.

S3 — Frozen builder scripts are not portable
-------------------------------------------
build_o2_source_bank.py and build_o3_seed_panel.py contain absolute pre-freeze /mnt/data staging paths.
The frozen included source bank and seed panel themselves are valid and hash-checked, and the official Scout run is reproducible from those included inputs.
But full third-party regeneration of those inputs requires editing the builder paths.
V1.1 should use arguments/relative paths.

S4 — Sparse action materialization is intentional and was functioning as designed
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
At r64, 328,605 legal relation additions existed across the selected parent panel; only 2,432 were materialized (32 per parent) before exact child deduplication.
This is Scout sampling, not a census.

An audit of sampled ranks found:

- 0 parents missing a representative of any available typed relation class;
- 0 parents missing each declared structural stress category when that category was available.

So the bounded action panel is internally coherent, but absence claims remain weak by design.


7. WHAT THE r0→r64 RUN ACTUALLY EARNS
=====================================

It earns a trustworthy exact bounded trajectory for one construction axis:

  repeated lawful inter-O2 incidence addition among fixed 3–6-entity O3 seeds,

under deterministic bounded action and carrier panels.

Within that trajectory we can safely say:

- relation addition remains live at r64;
- rich connectivity/cycle/parallel/multiparent/selectivity phenomena are represented;
- exact/resource states continue changing at r64;
- the inherited 18 typed Bridge relation classes are all represented;
- no official V1.0 Scout trigger fired under the frozen implementation.

We should NOT presently infer from V1.0 that:

- a genuine O3 rulebook has stabilized;
- O3 current-action classes fail to recur/compress;
- d2 is behaviorally decoupled/quiet;
- more r3 alone is the uniquely correct next axis;
- O3 maturation is absent by r64.


8. RECOMMENDED NEXT STEP
========================

DO NOT rerun r0→r64.
DO NOT simply extend unchanged V1.0 to r128.

Freeze Scout3 V1.1 as an observer/axis repair.

Minimum V1.1 changes should be:

1. Correct H1
   Define H1 as genuinely CURRENT availability/action support, without exact remaining multiplicities or accumulated resource counts in the support identity.
   Exact counts may re-enter only in H2/fixed-point refinement if future behavior proves them necessary.

2. Add an O3-sensitive grammar observer
   MAIN must not be only the inherited 18 RA/RU relation types.
   Use exact anonymous relational role/refinement information that can distinguish new organization without importing geometry — e.g. typed incidence role refinement, anonymous endpoint-role neighborhoods, factorization/common-successor structure, and transition-support classes.

3. Upgrade d2 from “quiet grammar control” to interaction control
   On the deterministic d2 panel, actually materialize a bounded exact set of earned d2 transitions and recompute O3 support/grammar. Record a d2→O3 transition profile.

4. Add / preregister a fresh-O2-entity growth axis
   g3: attach a new graduated Q entity to an existing H through one lawful typed incidence while keeping all entities distinct.
   This can be a thin Scout lane initially rather than a full Cartesian census.

5. Repair the frozen spec and portable builders
   Resolve 16/32 vs 24/64 wording; make builders path-parameterized; implement true lineage if retained.

Then:

- replay only the corrected V1.1 observers over the already-valid r0→r64 trajectory;
- treat the audit-only support result in this bundle as hypothesis-generating only;
- if V1.1 still has no Scout trigger, freeze the prospective extension using unseen r>64 and/or g3/d2 interaction data.


9. PLAIN CONCLUSION
===================

Scout3 did not fail. The computation is good.

But we made two familiar observational mistakes:

- the “same abilities now” camera secretly remembered too much exact resource detail, making things look unique;
- the “new grammar” camera watched an alphabet that was almost completely inherited and necessarily finite, making things look settled.

At the same time, the supposedly quiet internal-O2 control is actually changing external O3 availability in roughly four out of ten legal internal moves, and the whole r-run only packs more relations into 3–6 fixed O2 entities rather than letting an O3 organization recruit new O2 entities.

So r64 is a very useful roadmap result — but not a reason to blindly climb to r128.

The right next move is to fix Scout3's camera and axes while keeping every expensive r0→r64 checkpoint.

INFINITY GRID — SCOUT2-B V1.3 k0→k128 AUDIT
Date: 2026-08-27
Scope: scientific + implementation audit of the corrected V1.3 observer replay over the frozen V1.2 k0→k128 relation-rank trajectory.

EXECUTIVE VERDICT
=================
1. EXECUTION / FREEZE / SOURCE-INTEGRITY: PASS.
2. V1.3 OBSERVER IMPLEMENTATION VS ITS FROZEN SPEC: PASS for the stated one-step SUPPORT quotient.
3. V1.3 CORRECTION OF THE V1.2 “EDGE-HISTORY IN SUPPORT” ERROR: PASS.
4. EMPIRICAL CLAIM THAT RECURRENT CURRENT-ACTION-SUPPORT CLASSES EXIST: PASS.
5. INTERPRETATION AS A MATURE HIGHER-ORDER RELATIONAL NODE/ENTITY: NOT EARNED.
6. CRITICAL REASON: V1.3 SUPPORT IS NOT A TRANSITION CONGRUENCE. Exact carriers with the same V1.3 support can have different legal NEXT support outcomes under the same frozen relation-add algebra. The quotient describes which actions are available now, not how the object behaves after those actions.
7. ADDITIONAL WARNING: the final k128 core is rapidly losing selected abundance and multiparent support at the horizon, so it may be a transient resource-support chamber rather than a durable entity.
8. RECOMMENDATION: do not graduate the V1.3 core and do not merely extend the current Gate-1 unchanged. Freeze a prospective V1.4 that adds action-labeled transition congruence / partition-refinement before using unseen k129+ data.

A. EXECUTION, FREEZE, AND REPRODUCIBILITY
========================================
The official V1.3 replay remains mechanically sound.
- Frozen V1.3 freeze SHA-256 reproduced:
  35836002f9d563016afa6d95c1e9285bb95b26231d94201be7a297f4d73c84a4
- Frozen parent V1.2 science SHA-256:
  49bf8dadf2a5a8a92c3318b262ce1fd64730f5ebae6807982b10a7cb2b8e11ea
- V1.3 result science SHA-256:
  47e8e0a1e255ebdfc479a2e4527ab26a5076c1f57d5c5e1cb26832e9cc5d877a
- Official verifier rerun: PASS.
- 129 observer checkpoints and 97 evaluation checkpoints verified.
- Parent trajectory manifest verified by the official verifier.
- P2 sufficient at every V1.3 checkpoint.
- The preflight correction occurred before V1.3 science output and the corrected code/spec were re-frozen before the official replay.

An independent support-signature recomputation was also performed by audit code that did not call V1.3 support_signature_v13(). It recomputed the frozen formula on 4,224 deterministic carrier samples spread over early, middle and late k levels. Result: 4,224/4,224 exact support-hash agreement, 0 mismatches.

Conclusion: the V1.3 files implement the frozen current-support definition correctly.

B. WHAT V1.3 DEFINES — AND WHAT IT DOES NOT
===========================================
V1.3 identifies an anonymous connected carrier only by the sorted multiset of per-node action colors:
  A_i = (free-port SUPPORT mask, STRICT internal-template support mask, CROSS_RANK internal-template support mask).

This is a valid encoding of CURRENT one-step action availability under the frozen action law:
- current internal-lift action support is encoded by the two 77-bit masks;
- current relation-add action TYPES are determined by endpoint free-support masks plus the fixed Bridge law;
- existing retained-edge multiplicity is not read by relation-add legality except through capacity/usage already reflected in current free support.

The frozen spec is appropriately explicit that this is only a SUPPORT quotient and does NOT claim:
- exact child identity;
- transition multiplicity;
- long-horizon equivalence.

This limitation is decisive for interpreting Gate 1. Equal current action support is weaker than behavioral substitutability.

C. THE CENTRAL AUDIT ATTACK: TRANSITION CONGRUENCE
=================================================
A mature reusable higher-order node should eventually support some version of substitution: exact internal realizations assigned to the same macro state should not secretly disagree about what that macro state can become after an allowed action.

The audit therefore performed a post-hoc KILL TEST that was NOT part of V1.3 and is not promoted to an official V1.3 result:

For exact carriers sharing one V1.3 support signature, independently generate every frozen legal one-relation child, exact-deduplicate the children for each parent, map those children back to V1.3 support signatures, and compare the resulting SETS of next support states across the exact realizations.

If one current V1.3 support class is a one-step transition congruence, all exact realizations behind it must have the same next-support set under the relation-add axis (up to the declared anonymous action equivalence).

The final V1.3 core FAILS this test at the horizon.

Final core:
  816f1ea35e9e46db30127ff043b0d30f1a194f54624f6de015e4b4204f8b0f3b

At k128 there are 4 selected exact realizations behind this one V1.3 support state.
All four currently expose the same V1.3 action support, and each has 16 exact one-relation children.
But the four exact realizations split into TWO different next-support profiles:
- 3 exact realizations can reach three V1.3 support states;
- 1 exact realization can reach only two of those states.

The extra reachable child support in the first group is:
  650b36adc8e1...
It is absent from the fourth realization.

The cause is precisely information V1.3 intentionally discards: exact free COUNTS. In one realization, a currently-positive port type may have one copy left, so consuming it changes the support mask; in another realization the same currently-enabled port type has multiple copies left, so the identical kind of action does not change support yet.

Thus:
  same CURRENT action set != same NEXT action-support behavior.

The divergence begins before the final checkpoint:
- k93 final-core realizations: 1 next-support profile;
- k97: 1;
- k112: 1;
- k124: 1;
- k127: 2;
- k128: 2.

This is not a special pathology of one core. Population-wide post-hoc relation-transition checks found:
- k97: 60 multi-realization support classes; 26 transition-divergent;
- k112: 60; 28 divergent;
- k124: 46; 19 divergent;
- k128: 51; 28 divergent.
At k128 the 28 divergent classes contain 514 selected exact carriers.

Conclusion: V1.3 successfully finds stable CURRENT capability states, but those states are not in general Markov/closed macro states under the relation-add transition law.

D. WHAT THE FINAL CORE REALLY LOOKS LIKE
========================================
The final support signature is genuinely present and recurrent. It is not a hash or lane artifact.
It is present continuously from k93 through k128 and meets the frozen 32-k Gate-1 criteria at endpoints k124…k128.

However, its terminal trajectory is not one of strengthening persistence:
  k93   3 selected exact realizations
  k94  36
  k95  65
  k96  91
  k97 106
  ...
  k124 132
  k125 177
  k126  62
  k127   7
  k128   4

Multiparent evidence for this class is present through k126 but FALSE at k127 and k128.
The class still has direct same-support parent persistence at both levels, but its selected realization count collapses sharply right at the frozen horizon.

The frozen Gate can remain positive because lineage-rich and multiplicity evidence are aggregated over the whole 32-k window. That is valid under the spec, but it is not strong enough for final graduation.

An independent reconstruction of the full pre-selection relation-add pool also confirms that the class is real before lane selection, but rare at the horizon:
- k124 full pool: 1,092 / 40,958 = 2.666% of exact children; selected 132 / 874;
- k128 full pool: 72 / 50,273 = 0.143% of exact children; selected 4 / 941.

So the class is not merely selected into existence, but its abundance is strongly declining.

E. THE “CONTINUOUS LATE REGIME” IS A RELAY, NOT ONE OBJECT
===========================================================
The result report correctly says that some Gate-1 candidate exists at every evaluation endpoint k75…k128. But this should not be read as one support class persisting as a mature entity through all 54 levels.

Different support signatures take over across the interval. Examples:
- 9b003e59cfc1... qualifies at endpoints k75…k104;
- c057844682eb... k78…k96;
- df10396c5b99... k88…k117;
- f4181ee5e17d... k102…k125;
- 816f1ea35e9e... k124…k128.

Across the full replay, 17 distinct support signatures satisfy the core subcriteria at one or more endpoints.
This is compatible with a sequence of recurrent resource-support “chambers” as capacities are depleted, not yet proof of one higher-order entity.

The earlier k48 candidate disappearing at k63 remains an important warning of the same kind.

F. ACTION-GRAMMAR STABILIZATION: TRUE BUT LIMITED
=================================================
V1.3 correctly finds no new IA/RA/EA/MK grammar atoms after k2. The audit reproduces that chronology.

But the scientific interpretation should stay narrow:
- the action alphabet is already structurally bounded by the previously earned finite ingredients (77 internal templates, 18 relation types, finite marker vocabulary);
- what k0…k2 establishes is EARLY COVERAGE SATURATION of the observed action/structural vocabulary under this population, not a new theorem that the action language is finite.

Late novelty remains NC resource/interface-state novelty and is genuinely active through k128.

G. LANE, MODULATION, AND COMPRESSION EVIDENCE
=============================================
No implementation mismatch was found in the repaired D/E criteria. V1.3 correctly implements:
- lane-multi evidence in >=8 checkpoints rather than the V1.2 “same lanes forever” bug;
- regeneration OR multiparent evidence in >=8 checkpoints;
- genuine fail-closed P2/control handling.

But three interpretation guards are needed:

1. “Independent lanes” are not statistically independent samples.
D,T,C,I,L are deterministic correlated selectors over the same pool. Lane multiplicity is useful selection-robustness evidence, not independent replication in the probabilistic sense.

2. H1 modulation is panel-global, not core-specific.
The code counts a checkpoint if ANY selected carrier is modulated. Therefore phrases such as “the core is modulated throughout the window” are not supported by H1 unless core-specific modulation is separately checked.

3. I1 compression is panel-global, not core-specific.
The reported k128 4.056x value is len(selected panel)/number of V1.3 support classes. It is not the final core’s own compression statistic. The final core has 4 selected exact realizations mapping to one support at k128 (4x selected multiplicity); its full-pool multiplicity is 72-to-1 at k128. These are different quantities and should not be conflated.

H. LATENT FINAL-STATUS LOGIC ISSUE
=================================
The current finalizer sets RESOURCE_STATE_NOVELTY_AFTER_ENTITY_V1_3 whenever ANY Gate-1 entity candidate occurred anywhere earlier in the replay and late NC novelty remains.

Therefore, in a hypothetical continuation where a candidate appeared earlier but disappeared before the final horizon, the finalizer could still emit RESOURCE_STATE_NOVELTY_AFTER_ENTITY_V1_3 even though no entity candidate exists at the terminal checkpoint.

This did NOT falsify the actual k128 result because k128 itself is a Gate-1 candidate. But it must be corrected before a prospective continuation.

I. WHAT V1.3 HAS ACTUALLY EARNED
================================
SUPPORTED:
- the V1.2 observer defect was genuinely repaired at the level intended;
- current one-step action availability admits many-to-one anonymous support classes;
- some support classes recur for long k intervals while exact internal wiring changes;
- exact network realizations can therefore differ while exposing the same CURRENT capability vocabulary;
- this phenomenon is real in the full pre-selection pool, not only in the selected panel;
- whole O2 resource-state closure is not earned by k128.

NOT YET SUPPORTED:
- exact substitution of a V1.3 support class for its hidden network;
- one-step transition congruence of the final core;
- long-horizon behavioral equivalence;
- a graduated mature higher-order relational node;
- a single persistent entity spanning the entire k75…k128 late candidate regime.

The right scientific name for the V1.3 discovery is therefore closer to:
  RECURRENT CURRENT-ACTION-SUPPORT TYPES
than to:
  MATURE HIGHER-ORDER NODES.

J. RECOMMENDED NEXT STEP
========================
Do NOT rerun k0…k128.
Do NOT discard V1.3; it was a useful and correct support-level experiment.
Do NOT graduate the V1.3 core.

Before any unseen k129+ science, freeze a V1.4 prospective test that asks the stronger question required for a reusable higher-order object.

Recommended V1.4 additions:
1. TRANSITION CONGRUENCE / LABELED SUCCESSOR PROFILE.
   For exact realizations assigned to one candidate macro class, corresponding allowed action classes must induce the same quotient successor support (or the same set of allowed quotient successors, depending on the frozen semantics).
   This should cover relation-add and, if the higher-order object is meant to expose the full earned action set, internal-lift actions as well.

2. PARTITION REFINEMENT RATHER THAN A HAND-INVENTED EXTRA SCALAR.
   Start from V1.3 current-support colors and iteratively refine classes by their action-labeled successor classes until stable. This is the natural finite-algebra/bisimulation-style way to discover whatever extra state is actually required. It avoids guessing “capacity,” “distance,” “axis,” or geometry.

3. TERMINAL DURABILITY.
   A graduation gate should require the candidate to remain transition-congruent and non-collapsing in the terminal unseen portion, not merely accumulate enough evidence earlier in a rolling window. The k125→k128 collapse shows why.

4. PRE-SELECTION CHECKPOINTS AT A FEW PROSPECTIVE LEVELS.
   The selected-panel scanner remains useful, but at sparse milestone k values reconstruct/retain enough full-pool summary to verify that a candidate is not solely a lane-selection phenomenon.

5. REPORT GLOBAL AND CANDIDATE-SPECIFIC EVIDENCE SEPARATELY.
   Keep panel compression/modulation as controls, but do not attribute them to the candidate unless measured on that candidate.

6. FIX FINAL STATUS LOGIC.
   “...AFTER_ENTITY...” at a terminal horizon should require a terminal Gate-1/stronger candidate, not merely any historical candidate.

7. USE UNSEEN k129+ ONLY AFTER THE V1.4 DEFINITION IS FROZEN.
   The exact raw-capacity ceiling k<=250 still applies. Stop earlier on actual relation-capacity saturation.

PLAIN-LANGUAGE SUMMARY
======================
V1.3 fixed the previous camera. It really can now see groups of very differently wired networks that, at the present moment, can do the same kinds of things.

That is real and interesting.

But the audit found the next hidden layer. Two networks can look identical to V1.3 today and still react differently after tomorrow’s connection is added, because V1.3 remembers only whether a port type is still available, not how many copies remain. Near k128 this happens inside the very core we were excited about.

So we have found a real “capability type,” but we have NOT yet earned a higher-order node that can replace its hidden network in future algebra.

The beautiful part is that we do not need to invent the missing property. We can let the algebra tell us what it is by refining classes according to their actual successor behavior. If a compact stable state survives that refinement on unseen k129+ data, then we will have a much stronger candidate for the intermediate higher-order node we have been wondering about.

INFINITY GRID — SCOUT2-B V1.2 k0→k128 AUDIT
Date: 2026-08-27
Scope: scientific + implementation audit of the completed frozen Scout2-B V1.2 relation-rank run.

EXECUTIVE VERDICT
=================
1. EXECUTION / CHECKPOINT INTEGRITY: PASS.
2. OPTIMIZED IMPLEMENTATION VS FROZEN SEMANTICS: PASS, including independent late-rank tests at k32/k64/k96/k128.
3. OFFICIAL k0→k128 TRAJECTORY DATA: TRUSTWORTHY within the frozen relation-add semantics.
